تهتلكي (form VIII)
# تَهْتَلِكِي (tahtalikī) /tah.ta.li.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# تُهْتَلَكِي (tuhtalakī) /tuh.ta.la.kiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
